name: zclass_any_node_matches_predicate_recursive
description: zClass::AnyNodeMatchesPredicateRecursive returns one when the predicate accepts the root or any child reached through listB, scanning children in reverse order.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive predicate walker; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x452810 validates calling the predicate for the root, then recursively scanning root->listB from listCountB - 1 down to zero and returning 1 on the first accepted node.
The native smoke verifies a deep child match returns 1 and clearing that child predicate condition returns 0.
